name: Coding agents
description: One set of blocks for every coding agent: its plan's limits, its sessions, its usage by day, project and model, and one project's. A block's `agent:` names whose (claude-code, codex...): each agent's plugin draws them, read from that agent's own files, and with that plugin off its blocks are off too.

agent-limits.description: an agent's plan limits (the session, the week, a month's included usage): how much is used and when each renews
agent-limits.live: the agent's account, asked through its CLI or its own files on the machine the server runs on

agent.description: whose: an agent's plugin (claude-code, codex, cursor, grok-bot)

account.description: one account's (its id, like default or personal); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)

agent-sessions.description: an agent's sessions open now, then the latest ones (and Claude Code's Remote Control servers)
agent-sessions.live: the agent's own files on the machine the server runs on

agent.description: whose: an agent's plugin (claude-code, codex, opencode...)

recent.description: how many recent sessions to list after the open ones

account.description: one account's (its id: a Claude Code account, a Hermes profile, an OpenClaw agent); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)

agent-usage.description: an agent's value at list prices (or the cost it recorded) and tokens per day, today and over the last days
agent-usage.live: the agent's own files on the machine the server runs on

agent.description: whose: an agent's plugin (claude-code, codex, opencode...)

days.description: how many days back it covers

account.description: one account's (its id: a Claude Code account, a Hermes profile, an OpenClaw agent); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)
